Parfflo's Sixty Six PARFFLO Hookah Blast Nixodine sits in our Nixodine range, built for adults who want a ready-to-use device with a listed capacity of 40K Puffs and a flavor profile offering a cooling finish that lifts the flavor on every inhale.

Sixty Six PARFFLO Hookah Blast Nixodine is listed at $16.99 - $79.99 in our Nixodine range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Nixodine](/shop/nixodine/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Icy / Menthol points to a cooling finish that lifts the flavor on every inhale. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Parfflo
- **Category:** Nixodine
- **Flavor:** Icy / Menthol
- **Nicotine strength:** 5% Nixodine
- **Capacity:** 40K Puffs
- **Packaging:** Single Device, 5-Pack Bundle
- **Price:** $16.99 - $79.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Listed in a dedicated range:** so you can compare Nixodine options side by side.
- **Clear specifications:** strength and capacity are shown on this page and on the label.

### Strength and size options
This listing offers more than one option — pack sizes Single Device, 5-Pack Bundle. Choose yours above the Add to Cart button and the price updates to match, then set the quantity you need. Your choice appears in your cart and on your order confirmation, so there is no guessing at fulfillment.

## Who it suits
Sixty Six PARFFLO Hookah Blast Nixodine suits adult users curious about Nixodine and anyone comparing it with standard nicotine salt devices.

## Using and caring for it
Use as directed on the packaging, take short puffs, keep the device upright and away from heat, and do not open or modify it. Dispose of used devices according to local rules for electronics and batteries, and keep them out of reach of children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
